hooks.command: jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty" | { read -r cmd; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qiE "(^|[;&|]|[[:space:]])sudo([[:space:]]|$)|rm[[:space:]]+(-[a-zA-Z]*r[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*|-[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*r[a-zA-Z]*|--recursive[[:space:]]+.*--force|--force[[:space:]]+.*--recursive)"; then jq -n --arg reason "위험한 명령어가 감지되어 차단되었습니다: rm -rf, sudo 사용은 허용되지 않습니다." '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:$reason}}'; else echo "{}"; fi; }
